change: Trial-removed CAP_CHOWN and CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE from the sandbox container capability set.
observations: The service started with both capabilities removed.
The first Node.js package-cache job reached cleanup, where the root worker could not delete a Node-created file owned by UID 65532 because CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE was absent.
The BackgroundService stopped; Compose restarted the sandbox service.
CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE was restored and the sandbox service is running again. CAP_CHOWN remains removed. The initial four-ecosystem acceptance was interrupted; a subsequent full rerun is recorded below.
dataImpact: No application database, business-data volume, image, build cache, or persistent SQL data was modified. The one temporary queue record created by the smoke test was removed.
followUp: The four-ecosystem acceptance passed with CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE restored and CHOWN removed. Runtime now mounts the clean deploy/docker/sandbox-package-cache-runtime path; the original generated fixtures remain preserved in the legacy ignored path and are not mounted.
